// diagnostic

E0310

`T?` used where plain `T` expected

What

`T?` used where plain `T` expected

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0310

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0310: tests/ui/option_where_plain.stderr.

Error [E0310]: this needs Int (a whole number), but the value is ?Int
  --> tests/ui/option_where_plain.jet:7:10
    |
  7 |     show(x)
    |          ^
 Why: a plain value is required here, not an optional one
 Fix: test with `== Val(...)` or `== None` first, e.g. `if x == Val(n) { ... }`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0310
